data.name: Tropicalypse
data.detailed_description:
Tropicalypse is an innovative first- and third-person co-op zombie shooter set in a lush tropical apocalypse. Seamlessly switch between perspectives as you and your team fight to survive in a dynamic world shaped by procedural stories and evolving quests. Every decision your group makes influences how the narrative unfolds, creating a unique experience each time you play.

Designed for cooperative gameplay, Tropicalypse emphasizes teamwork, strategy, and adaptability as players face relentless hordes of the undead and explore a vibrant yet dangerous island environment.

This project is more than just a game. It is an ongoing journey in both gameplay and development. As the developer, I am committed to continuously expanding Tropicalypse with new co-op mechanics, features, and content, ensuring a constantly evolving experience. Whether you are coordinating tactics, scavenging resources, or fighting side by side, Tropicalypse grows alongside both its players and its creator.
